question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of oil product pipelines and a list of refineries in Spain, with location, operator, capacity and status?

answer.summary: Refineries: CORES publishes an xlsx with the 10 Spanish refineries by owner group and crude capacity (kt/y, to 2025); PRTR-España gives operator, point and status on each complex page. Pipelines: the IGN BTN has national oleoducto lines (vector tiles, GeoPackage), without owner or status; CNMC says Exolum owns the network (about 4 000 km). Pipeline capacity and in-service status are not published.
main_caveats: BTN oleoducto lines carry no owner, product (crude vs refined) or in-service flag; the whole-country GeoPackage from CNIG could not be fetched with curl, only the vector-tile service was tested.
CORES capacity is in thousand tonnes per year; Tenerife keeps 4 500 kt although it is not operational (CORES English note), so exclude it for operating capacity.
Concawe's Petronor point is 15.9 km off the PRTR point and its terms allow only personal non-commercial use; Climate TRACE's Cartagena point is 7.9 km off. PRTR and OSM are the reference.
Only Andalucía's regional WFS was found with named pipeline sections; the other regions were not checked individually.
Moeve's site blocks automated clients, so Moeve figures come from CORES and Concawe, not from the company.
answer.confidence_reason: Refinery data cross-checked across CORES, PRTR, Concawe and Climate TRACE; pipeline completeness rests on one decoded BTN tile plus the Atlas total (4 106 km) against CNMC's 4 000 km.

sources.name: Spanish Refinery Capacity (Capacidad de refino en España), annual series by refinery
sources.publisher: CORES (Corporación de Reservas Estratégicas de Productos Petrolíferos), from company data
sources.format: xlsx (sheets Start, Crude, Repsol, Moeve, BP, Asesa, Total National). The annual statistical report xlsx has the same table by process unit in sheet 'Capacidad Refinerías españolas'.
sources.summary: Spanish Refinery Capacity (Capacidad de refino en España), annual series by refinery
sources.coverage_note: Spain, all refineries of Repsol, Moeve (ex Cepsa), BP and ASESA; crude capacity series 1984-2025.
sources.data_date: Figures at 31 December of each year; file updated 30-07-2026 (HTTP Last-Modified 2026-09-10).
caveats: Consult the main caveats and the complete reading traps and access evidence in the detail.

example.example_request: curl -sL -o refinery-capacity.xlsx "https://www.cores.es/sites/default/files/archivos/estadisticas/refinery-capacity.xlsx"; open sheet 'Crude'; headers in row 6, data from row 7 (1984); row 48 is 2025.
example.example_result: 2025 row (thousand t): Cartagena 11000, La Coruña 6000, Puertollano 7500, Tarragona 9000, Bilbao 11000, Tenerife 4500, San Roque 12200, La Rábida 11200, Castellón 5400, ASESA 1400, national total 79200.

problems: curl to centrodedescargas.cnig.es returned 'Empty reply from server' on https and a 302 on http; the GeoPackage was not downloaded. The tile service answered normally.

example.example_request: curl -sS -o tile.pbf "https://vt-btn.idee.es/1.0.0/btn/tile/14/6166/8048.pbf" (URL pattern {z}/{y}/{x}); decode the protobuf and read layer 'btn0701l_con_comb'.
example.example_result: Layer btn0701l_con_comb, 10 features in the tile; first: {'id': 285834354, 'tipo_0701': '01 OLEODUCTO', 'situa_0701': '01 SUBTERRÁNEO', 'f_alta': '2018/06/28'}; segment ends decoded to (40.60133, -3.16441) and (40.61071, -3.15265), which match the start of OSM way 258610918 (operator Exolum, substance oil, from 40.60149, -3.16120).
